telos.statement: Determine the smallest justified capability for fitting system structure to an accepted need, constraints and required qualities, without creating a new agent or discipline boundary unless it changes material decisions.
telos.success_condition: Distinguish whether Solution Architecture is (a) a better name/telos for the existing Architecture Decision Discriminator, (b) a missing front-door requirements/quality-attribute sub-capability, or (c) a genuinely separate peer function.

current_state.summary: Neta owns product perception/sensemaking discrimination; R&D v0.2 candidate owns resource↔telos calibration; Architecture Decision Discriminator v0 is a candidate capability for live structural decisions and already takes TELOS, CURRENT STATE, MATERIAL PRESSURE, KNOWN CONSTRAINTS and authorities. Prior system-design research narrowed a possible residual to measurable required property/workload/bottleneck evidence rather than a pattern knowledge base.
known_constraints: Do not infer a peer agent from an industry job title.
Do not let Architecture invent OWNER-owned telos or tradeoff acceptance.
Do not let Neta silently become architecture doctrine.
Do not let R&D absorb structural design merely because it allocates resources.
Prefer a bounded adaptation of an existing capability over BUILD.

decision_blocked.statement: Is Solution Architecture a distinct function in this ecosystem, or the correct framing of the existing Architecture Decision Discriminator; and what exact transformation, if any, is still unowned?
decision_blocked.current_default: Treat Solution Architecture as a hypothesis about the telos/boundary of the existing Architecture Decision Discriminator, not as a new agent.
decision_blocked.reversal_condition: Promote a distinct capability/peer only if repeated cases show an unowned need→requirements→structure transformation that changes decisions more cheaply/reliably than Neta + R&D + current Architecture Discriminator + authorities.

signals: The owner reframed the target from system-design concepts to the professional function of fitting architecture to need.
The existing Architecture Decision Discriminator already contains telos, constraints, tradeoffs and migration but may assume the architecture-relevant need is already sufficiently specified.
